item.title: TT-104 Add TaskStore undo
item.brief: Implement TT-104 exactly from BACKLOG.md. Add TaskStore.undo() that reverses the latest not-yet-undone successful add, complete or delete, in LIFO order across kinds. Undo add removes the task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores the exact task with same id. Never reuse ids, including after undoing add. Define NothingToUndo in tasktracker.store and raise it when history is exhausted. Failed operations must not enter undo history. Add standard-library unittest coverage for each operation, cross-kind LIFO, repeated undo, failed operations and id allocation. Preserve existing behavior outside these criteria. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket's implementation and tests as one separate commit.

item.title: TT-103 Search query syntax
item.brief: Implement TT-103 exactly from BACKLOG.md. Query terms split on whitespace except within double quoted phrases; all terms are ANDed. Bare/phrase title matches case-insensitively; tag:NAME matches an exact case-insensitive tag; status:open/done filters status. Define QueryError in tasktracker.search and raise it for unsupported field:value, unknown status, or unterminated quote. Blank query matches every task, preserving input order. Add standard-library unittest coverage for each syntax/error and combinations. Preserve existing behavior outside these criteria. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket's implementation and tests as one separate commit.

item.title: TT-101 Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement TT-101 exactly from BACKLOG.md. In tasktracker.dates, define InvalidDate(ValueError) and ensure every unsupported input raises it with the original text in the message. Reject impossible ISO calendar dates rather than clamping. Keep case-insensitive today/tomorrow and surrounding whitespace. Accept only +Nd offsets with N >= 0, where +0d is today; reject -3d and unsigned 3d. Add standard-library unittest coverage for all listed examples and relevant valid forms. Preserve all existing behavior outside these criteria. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket's implementation and tests as one separate commit.
